department: School of Computing — Department of Computer Science

deadline.value: August 2027 intake deadline is December 15, 2026 (January intake deadline is June 15 of the previous calendar year).
deadline.quote: August Intake: 15 December | January Intake: 15 June (of previous calendar year)

gre_subject.value: No ETS GRE Subject Test exists for computer science (ETS offers Subject Tests only in Mathematics, Physics, and Psychology).
gre_subject.quote: The GRE Subject Tests in Mathematics, Physics and Psychology measure undergraduate achievement in a particular field of study

supervisor.value: School of Computing PhD admissions and application pages do not state whether pre-admission supervisor commitment is required.

funding.value: NUS Research Scholarships (monthly emoluments plus full tuition fee subsidy, plus an additional S$500/month for two years after passing the PhD Qualifying Examination) and President's Graduate Fellowships are awarded competitively for up to 4 years.
funding.quote: Financial Assistance in the form of Research Scholarship is available, on a competitive-basis to all full-time students who meet the minimum criteria. The Research Scholarship will carry monthly emoluments, plus full tuition fee subsidy.

entry_route.value: Admits candidates with a good relevant bachelor's degree (at least 2nd Class Upper Honours or equivalent for Research Scholarships) or master's degree in computing or a related discipline.
entry_route.quote: The normal minimum entry qualifications for admission to the programme by research are a good relevant bachelor’s degree/master’s degree. Candidates applying for Research Scholarships must have obtained a bachelor’s degree with at least a 2nd Class Upper Honours, or its equivalent in Computing or related discipline.

app_fee.value: School of Computing charges a S$50 non-refundable online application fee (inclusive of GST) per PhD application.
app_fee.quote: A S$50 non-refundable application fee (per online application & inclusive of prevailing GST) is payable for our PhD programme.

gre_general.value: GRE is not required, though applicants are encouraged to submit scores (Indian university graduates may submit GATE scores instead).
gre_general.quote: GRE is not required, but applicants are encouraged to submit their GRE scores. Candidates who have graduated from Indian universities may submit GATE scores instead.

toefl_min.value: School of Computing requires a minimum TOEFL iBT score of 90 (or IELTS 6.0) when English proficiency testing is required.
toefl_min.quote: The minimum TOEFL scores for Internet Based Test (IBT) is 90; or IELTS score of 6.0.

ielts_min.value: School of Computing requires a minimum IELTS score of 6.0 (or TOEFL iBT 90) when English proficiency testing is required.
ielts_min.quote: The minimum TOEFL scores for Internet Based Test (IBT) is 90; or IELTS score of 6.0.

english_waiver.value: International applicants who graduated from universities where English was the main medium of communication are exempt from submitting TOEFL/IELTS scores.
english_waiver.quote: *International applicants who graduated from universities where English is not the main medium of communication must submit TOEFL (http://www.ets.org/) or IELTS (International English Language Testing System) (http://www.ielts.org) scores.

notes: School of Computing also offers a separate PhD in Information Systems (https://www.comp.nus.edu.sg/programmes/pg/phdis/) with the same admissions, TOEFL/IELTS, and GRE/GATE rules.
